public_health_question.v: Did passive surveillance in six states during June 1998–December 1999 identify any persons with illness meeting criteria for possible estuary-associated syndrome?

ev.q: This report summarizes passive surveillance for PEAS during June 1, 1998--December 31, 1999, which indicated no persons had illnesses that met PEAS criteria.
collects information about possible human health problems that may occur after exposure to estuarine water
This report summarizes passive surveillance for PEAS during June 1, 1998--December 31, 1999
Calls from persons requesting information or reporting symptoms that may be related to Pp or Pfiesteria -like organisms (PLOs) were recorded
Surveillance information was periodically transferred to CDC for data aggregation and dissemination to the public.
